005package org.wpilib.vision.process;
006
007import org.opencv.core.Mat;
008import org.wpilib.vision.camera.CvSink;
009import org.wpilib.vision.camera.VideoSource;
010import org.wpilib.vision.stream.CameraServerSharedStore;
011
012/**
013 * A vision runner is a convenient wrapper object to make it easy to run vision pipelines from robot
014 * code. The easiest way to use this is to run it in a {@link VisionThread} and use the listener to
015 * take snapshots of the pipeline's outputs.
016 *
017 * <p>This class is provided by the CameraServer VendorDep
018 *
019 * @param <P> Vision pipeline type.
020 * @see VisionPipeline
021 * @see VisionThread
022 * @see <a href="package-summary.html">vision</a>
023 */
024public class VisionRunner<P extends VisionPipeline> {
025  private final CvSink m_cvSink = new CvSink("VisionRunner CvSink");
026  private final P m_pipeline;
027  private final Mat m_image = new Mat();
028  private final Listener<? super P> m_listener;
029  private volatile boolean m_enabled = true;
030
031  /**
032   * Listener interface for a callback that should run after a pipeline has processed its input.
033   *
034   * @param <P> the type of the pipeline this listener is for
035   */
036  @FunctionalInterface
037  public interface Listener<P extends VisionPipeline> {
038    /**
039     * Called when the pipeline has run. This shouldn't take much time to run because it will delay
040     * later calls to the pipeline's {@link VisionPipeline#process process} method. Copying the
041     * outputs and code that uses the copies should be <i>synchronized</i> on the same mutex to
042     * prevent multiple threads from reading and writing to the same memory at the same time.
043     *
044     * @param pipeline the vision pipeline that ran
045     */
046    void copyPipelineOutputs(P pipeline);
047  }
048
049  /**
050   * Creates a new vision runner. It will take images from the {@code videoSource}, send them to the
051   * {@code pipeline}, and call the {@code listener} when the pipeline has finished to alert user
052   * code when it is safe to access the pipeline's outputs.
053   *
054   * @param videoSource the video source to use to supply images for the pipeline
055   * @param pipeline the vision pipeline to run
056   * @param listener a function to call after the pipeline has finished running
057   */
058  public VisionRunner(VideoSource videoSource, P pipeline, Listener<? super P> listener) {
059    this.m_pipeline = pipeline;
060    this.m_listener = listener;
061    m_cvSink.setSource(videoSource);
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Runs the pipeline one time, giving it the next image from the video source specified in the
066   * constructor. This will block until the source either has an image or throws an error. If the
067   * source successfully supplied a frame, the pipeline's image input will be set, the pipeline will
068   * run, and the listener specified in the constructor will be called to notify it that the
069   * pipeline ran.
070   *
071   * <p>This method is exposed to allow teams to add additional functionality or have their own ways
072   * to run the pipeline. Most teams, however, should just use {@link #runForever} in its own thread
073   * using a {@link VisionThread}.
074   */
075  public void runOnce() {
076    Long id = CameraServerSharedStore.getCameraServerShared().getRobotMainThreadId();
077
078    if (id != null && Thread.currentThread().threadId() == id) {
079      throw new IllegalStateException(
080          "VisionRunner.runOnce() cannot be called from the main robot thread");
081    }
082    runOnceInternal();
083  }
084
085  private void runOnceInternal() {
086    long frameTime = m_cvSink.grabFrame(m_image);
087    if (frameTime == 0) {
088      // There was an error, report it
089      String error = m_cvSink.getError();
090      CameraServerSharedStore.getCameraServerShared().reportDriverStationError(error);
091    } else {
092      // No errors, process the image
093      m_pipeline.process(m_image);
094      m_listener.copyPipelineOutputs(m_pipeline);
095    }
096  }
097
098  /**
099   * A convenience method that calls {@link #runOnce()} in an infinite loop. This must be run in a
100   * dedicated thread, and cannot be used in the main robot thread because it will freeze the robot
101   * program.
102   *
103   * <p><strong>Do not call this method directly from the main thread.</strong>
104   *
105   * @throws IllegalStateException if this is called from the main robot thread
106   * @see VisionThread
107   */
108  public void runForever() {
109    Long id = CameraServerSharedStore.getCameraServerShared().getRobotMainThreadId();
110
111    if (id != null && Thread.currentThread().threadId() == id) {
112      throw new IllegalStateException(
113          "VisionRunner.runForever() cannot be called from the main robot thread");
114    }
115    while (m_enabled && !Thread.interrupted()) {
116      runOnceInternal();
117    }
118  }
119
120  /** Stop a RunForever() loop. */
121  public void stop() {
122    m_enabled = false;
123  }
124}
